tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// gtan 'jog gi yi ge 'gyur med drang thig ces bya ba bzhugs// stobs bcu mnga' ba'i dbang phyug rdzogs sangs rgyas// rang nyid bka' don mkhas pa'i tshul gsum gyis// 'grel byed lha rig skye bar rim zlos pa// bstan pa'i snang byed gong ma rnam lngar 'dud// phyi nang rig pa'i gzhung gi dag byed rgyun// ji snyed mkhyen pa'i gsus par bskyil te slar// legs bshad yan lag brgyad ldan thar pa'i srog /brtan byed e waṃ par grags drang srong che// mgon de'i rgyal tshab rim byon chos rnams la// chos mig dri med thob pa thams cad kyi// drin las legs bris grong bzhin bla nas blar// 'degs pa'i snying stobs lhun po'i spun zla can// sde dge sa skyong rim byon bsngags pa'i 'os// 'gro la snying rje rab rgyas rgyal ba'i sras// bsod nams mthu chen rgyal po'i skye ba bzung*// brtse dang bloṃ groṃs rab rgyas phrin las kyis// rgyaṃ mtshoṃ'i gos yangs khyab pa mi yi rje// sngon bsags las dbang gdugs dkar kun gyi blar// 'phyo ba'i grib mar ngal bsos sgom chen pas// lha de'i sku drin las thob dngos rdzas rnams// 'brel thogs rgyud du bsod nams tshogs rdzogs phyir// dge 'dun bsnyen bkur stob byed spyi las par// lo dus dkon mchog mchod rten gtan 'jog rnams// mi bdag bka' tham mtshams sprin dang 'grogs pa'i// 'phyugs med yi ge'i ri dwags rtags can ngom// de'ang bcom ldan shākya seng ge'i bstan pa rin po che'i nang gsel rje btsun sa skya pa zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ de'i ring lugs 'chang ba rgyu skar khrod kyi kun phan dkyil 'khor lta bu ni/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i rgyal tshab rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po pa de nyid kyi chos sgor zhugs pa'i sgom chen sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin pa bdag mkhas shing grub pa'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu mang po las legs gsungs zab rgyas dam pa'i chos kyi bgo skal ma nyung tsam thob/

thob pa rnams kyang nyams len gyi 'brel pa 'jog phyir/ sgrub gnas dben gnas rnams su 'tsho ba ngan ngon tsam la blo bkug nas dge sbyor lhur bgyis pa na/ sa skyong byang chub sems dpa' lcam dral gyi snyan dbang du nges par brten/ byams brtse'i spyan ras kyi gzigs pas lhung ba'i gnang sbyin gya nom pa stsal bar brten pa'i sku rim zhabs brtan gyi bsnyen mtshams 'ga' zhig bgyis pa dang*/ skabs rer sku rtsar bcar te/ sa dbang dam pa nyid gtsang dbus phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba na'ang sku srung gi rim gro pa'i tshul du khrid cing skal ba bzang po thob pa'i bdag rkyen rnams gzugs su bgyir btub na/ rgya mtsho chen po chu'i phung po'i tshad kyis 'gran mi nus pa ma mchis par stsal/ res 'ga' sing rnam brag gi ri khrod du dge sbyor byed cing sdod chog par gnang ba sogs bdag rkyen stsal ba'i rgyus/ lhun po'i ngos la brten pa'i 'dab chags gser gyi kha dog tu snang ba ltar/ sbyin pa'i bdag po gzhan dag nas kyang gson gshin rnams kyi ched du/ dbang bskur rjes gnang ring 'tsho'i cho ga bgyis pa rnams kyi yon 'bul du byin pa'i dkor rdzas dang*/ sa zhing thor bu yod pa rnams chud mi 'dza' bar/ dkon mchog mchod pa'i rten du 'gro ba byung na/ rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma gong ma zab zhi chos dbyings su gzugs sku'i spros pa brtul ba'i tshul bstan pa rnams dang*/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i dpung gnyen du gyur pa'i sde dge sa skyong yab mes gang dag byon pa rnams dang bcas pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ da ltar zhal bzhugs shing rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i dbu 'phang srid rtser 'degs pa'i lhag bsam gyi kho lag rdzogs shing*/ gcig tu sde bzhi dge bcu'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba'i rgyal srid bskal pa nam gnas kyi bar du brtan par bgyid pa'i khur chen 'degs phyir/

mi 'gyur gser gyi khri la mnga' bsgyur zhing byams dang brtse ba'i dbang phyug rgyal ba'i sras chen sa skyong blo gros rgya mtsho zhes yongs su grags pa'i yi ge'i zla 'od dkar po'i snang bas phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'gengs pa khu dbon bcas pa'i zhabs zung khri 'phang du bskal par brtan cing chos srid phrin las kyi 'khor los phyogs bral du bgrod pa'i phyir dang*/ bdag la re ltos bcas pa'i sbyin bdag gson gshin 'brel thogs rnams kyi rgyud la tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i ched du/ dpal lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang mthong na mngon par dga' ba gang der/ dge 'dun 'dus pa mang tshogs kyis lo re bzhin du hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod cho ga stong tshar re gsung bskul zhu ba'i thog ja thug bcu bzhi re stob pa dang*/ yon 'bul la du ba re 'gyed pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor mchod chas dang*/ nyer spyod bdun tshar re'i chas su/ mar rgya do/ rtsam pa zho gnyis/ nas 'dong nyi shu rtsa lnga re sprod pa bcas dgos rgyu'i rten/ dkar chen spyi pa gcig nas gcig tu rtsis sprad dgos rgyu'i rten 'jog la/ zhes pa nas 'dir dngos rdzas sogs bri/ 'dir smras pa/ dad dang 'byor ldan 'dab stong skyed tshal las// chos mthun spyod pa'i sbrang rtsi'i mgrin snyan gyis// 'bad pas bsags pa'i dngos 'byor zas kham dag /mchod sprin 'dod yon bskal par 'byung rgyur bskrun// dge tshogs lung rigs man ngag smra ba'i mchog /bye bas lan brgyar bsngags pa sa skya pa// e waṃ yi ges mtshan bstan lhan cig nyid// bshad sgrub phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas phyir bsngo// gang de'i lugs bzang zla tshes gtsug na 'dzin// sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor ral pa mtha' med brjid// dge bcur spyod pa'i sa skyong dpal gyi mgrin// chab 'bangs legs bris mgon du rgyal gyur cig

/sangs rgyas bstan pa'i yang snying 'dzin pa bdag /gzhan don bla na med pa'i byang chub che// mngon 'dod dam bca'i ri mo snying ga la// bris don snying pos nam yang mi stong shog /re zhig smon pa'i gnas mngon ma gyur pa// de srid dal rten bla ma lhag pa'i lha// 'bral med byang chub spyod pa rmad byung gis// 'brel thogs 'gro ba legs lam 'khrid par shog /gong gsal gtan tshigs 'di rnams dkar chen spyi ba gcig nas gcig tu rtsis sprod bya dgos rgyu dang*/ 'das bzhugs gson gshin mang po'i ched du dmigs pa'i kun rig stong chog gtang sgo bcas/ dus tshod tshes grangs cung zad kyang ma 'dzol bar byed dgos gtan tshigs 'gyur med me khyi zla tshes la dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab nas zhes bka' tham mo// zhes pa 'di'ang bla ma sgom chen sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin pa'i thugs bzhed bzhin gtan 'jog gi yi ge 'gyur med drang thig ces bya ba tshul rin gyis so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
